provenance.source: 112 DESIGN exemplars of docs/designs/h1-tier2-quarantine-split-2026-07-12.json (design_exemplars), quotes joined via docs/designs/h1-wave1-shakedown-packets-2026-07-12.json quote_anchor.verbatim.
provenance.leakage: DESIGN carve ONLY. The 77 sealed_eval items were never opened. The 78-held-out is SPENT.
provenance.class_assignment_rule: extracted_condition_type == WAIT_BIAS -> bias_vs_movement; else -> walkthrough_narration (the narrated-action-in-walkthrough surface).

note: Birth gate: for EACH named class, the gate-fires items must resolve to 'gate-strength' and the context-silent items to 'context' (BOTH polarities per class -- pre-reg §4). LLM-margin items are classified by the real Gemma call WITH their concept siblings as cross-reference (the harness fetches siblings by concept_id). A prompt that fails its own fixtures does not ship. Deterministic-terminal items (exclusion / rule-declaration / tangent) never touch the LLM and are EXACT on re-run.
